title: BROKEN SWORD II
subtitle: Revolution Software, 1997 · the Windows demo, on ScummVM 0.10.0 (2007): its Sword2 engine
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its id. Other switches: -g<scaler>, -f full screen, -m<volume> music, -s<volume> effects, -n no subtitles.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: sword2-win-demo-en/files/ from sword2-win-demo-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

controls: walk and act (left button), look (right button), the inventory at the top
_why: A 640x480 game in 16-bit colour, held to a native g++ build of 0.10.0 frame by frame (gate-scummvm010, 3,000 frames).
